title: Detailed skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Deck main body -->
  <path d='M12,48 Q12,42 20,42 L80,42 Q88,42 88,48 Q88,54 80,54 L20,54 Q12,54 12,48 Z' fill='#FF6B35'/>
  <!-- Deck top highlight strip -->
  <path d='M18,44 Q20,43 24,43 L76,43 Q80,43 82,44' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Deck bottom shadow strip -->
  <path d='M18,52 Q22,53 26,53 L74,53 Q78,53 82,52' stroke='#CC4A1F' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Grip tape pattern (small dashes on top) -->
  <line x1='24' y1='46' x2='30' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='46' x2='40' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='46' x2='50' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='46' x2='60' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='46' x2='70' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='46' x2='80' y2='46' stroke='#7A3A12' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Deck nose curve detail -->
  <path d='M12,48 Q10,45 14,43' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Deck tail curve detail -->
  <path d='M88,48 Q90,45 86,43' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Wooden deck edge (lighter orange) -->
  <path d='M14,50 L86,50' stroke='#FFD699' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Front truck baseplate -->
  <rect x='60' y='54' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0A0B0'/>
  <!-- Front truck hanger -->
  <path d='M62,58 L58,62 Q56,64 60,64 L74,64 Q78,64 76,62 L72,58 Z' fill='#808090'/>
  <!-- Front axle -->
  <line x1='55' y1='64' x2='79' y2='64' stroke='#606070' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front wheels -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='67' r='5' fill='#FFE033'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='67' r='2.5' fill='#FFC800'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='67' r='1' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='67' r='5' fill='#FFE033'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='67' r='2.5' fill='#FFC800'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='67' r='1' fill='#E6A800'/>
  
  <!-- Rear truck baseplate -->
  <rect x='26' y='54' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0A0B0'/>
  <!-- Rear truck hanger -->
  <path d='M28,58 L24,62 Q22,64 26,64 L40,64 Q44,64 42,62 L38,58 Z' fill='#808090'/>
  <!-- Rear axle -->
  <line x1='21' y1='64' x2='45' y2='64' stroke='#606070' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rear wheels -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='67' r='5' fill='#FFE033'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='67' r='2.5' fill='#FFC800'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='67' r='1' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='67' r='5' fill='#FFE033'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='67' r='2.5' fill='#FFC800'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='67' r='1' fill='#E6A800'/>
  
  <!-- Deck graphic - star decoration -->
  <polygon points='50,39 52,43 56,43 53,46 54,50 50,47 46,50 47,46 44,43 48,43' fill='#FFE066' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <!-- Deck graphic - small lightning bolts -->
  <polygon points='30,44 32,44 31,47 33,47 29,51 30,48 28,48' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <polygon points='66,44 68,44 67,47 69,47 65,51 66,48 64,48' fill='#FFE066'/>
  
  <!-- Kicktail upturn detail -->
  <path d='M14,48 Q14,54 18,56' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86,48 Q86,54 82,56' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Truck bolts -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#D0D0E0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#D0D0E0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#D0D0E0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#D0D0E0'/>
</svg>
